title: "Open Research"

I use computational and reproducible research workflows whenever data, ethics, and licensing conditions permit.

My research artifacts may include:

- analysis code,
- data-processing pipelines,
- computational appendices,
- validation outputs,
- reproducibility records,
- metadata crosswalks,
- visualization tools.
